What the evidence shows

How to read this

The score is reference-relativeBand levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.Source: L10

The score is reference-relative

Band levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.

The score is higher at low feedThe score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.Source: L08

The score is higher at low feed

The score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

Many onsets are censored6 of 12 onsets are censored by the look-back cap: a censored onset is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; the CENSORED slices are not evidence of precedence (Phase 8 F18); the UNCENSORED slices show no pre-onset excess.Source: Phase 8 censoring

Many onsets are censored

6 of 12 onsets are censored by the look-back cap: a censored onset is the look-back cap, so its window lies inside the KPI shift; the CENSORED slices are not evidence of precedence (Phase 8 F18); the UNCENSORED slices show no pre-onset excess.

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient airFrequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.Source: L07

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient air

Frequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.

There is no plant ground truthNo coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.Source: L01

There is no plant ground truth

No coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.
